title: acre works out the source edits that add, delete and copy nodes
body:
Plan and survey: `tmp-claude/2026-11-23-overnight/create-research.md` in the acre checkout. `scene::edit` has `move_edits` and `text_edits` only.

## Proposal

- `Scene` exposes the offset `size auto` shifts the drawing by, so a viewer turns a canvas point into source coordinates.
- `insert_edits` appends a one-line node at the end of the canvas body, before the timeline, at the indent of its neighbours, stable under `acre fmt`.
- `fresh_name` picks `KIND` + N, clashing with no word in the source, no reserved word and no repeat rename; and the edit that names an unnamed node.
- `delete_edits` removes one or more nodes cleanly, refusing while anything names them (checked by rebuilding the edited source).
- `copy_text` and `paste_edits` carry one or more nodes as text, renaming names inside the copy and its own references, offset +10 +10, as one insertion.
- Each edit set is one message, so one neovim undo step.
